requirement.normalizedRequirement: Compute T_f_kN = 1.1*F_f_kN and T_b_kN = 1.1*F_b_kN. Compute forward_design_thrust_T_r_kN = hydrodynamic_bollard_thrust_T_kN + 2.2*T_f_kN and backward_design_thrust_T_r_kN = 1.5*T_b_kN. Set design_thrust_T_r_kN = max(forward_design_thrust_T_r_kN, backward_design_thrust_T_r_kN) for both directions.
requirement.requiredInputs: Ff_kN, Fb_kN, and hydrodynamicBollardThrust_kN; the separate TRF-082 record covers the Table 6-8 fallback when bollard thrust is unknown
requirement.section: Maximum ice thrust on propeller Tf and Tb for open and ducted propellers
requirement.source: Ice Class Regulations and the Application Thereof
requirement.sourceText: The maximum forward and backward ice thrusts are T_f = 1.1*F_f [kN] (6.17) and T_b = 1.1*F_b [kN] (6.18). The design thrust along the propeller shaft line must be calculated using the formulae below. The greater value of the forward and backward direction loads shall be taken as the design load for both directions. Factors 2.2 and 1.5 take account of the dynamic magnification resulting from axial vibration. In a forward direction, T_r = T + 2.2*T_f [kN] (6.19). In a backward direction, T_r = 1.5*T_b [kN] (6.20).
